capabilities: Rank search results by graph proximity to one or more near notes
Combine text terms with tag and path filter chips
Tune scoring weights and distance falloff in settings
Show distance, title, body, and total score breakdowns in debug mode
disambiguation: Not a visual graph tool; it is a text search whose results are ranked by link distance in the graph.
extras: Author states search is fairly basic, weights are heuristic, and the index/graph is rebuilt from scratch each time the search modal opens.
intentEvidence: Use it when plain search returns too many hits and you want results related to specific notes or people.
problem: Obsidian's plain search returns too many hits and cannot rank results by how closely they relate to specific notes in the link graph.
summary: Search plugin that ranks notes by graph link proximity to chosen notes, combined with title and body text relevance.
